metadata.title: Owned Control Library
metadata.remarks: Control statements are original, authored work owned in this repository. Framework references are authored mappings keyed to public sources (NIST SP 800-53 rev 5 is public domain; SOC 2 TSC, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, HIPAA, NIST CSF 2.0, PCI DSS v4, GDPR are public standards/regulations). No content is derived from a licensed metaframework. Mappings are at control-family granularity; confirm exact sub-references against each source framework before audit use.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: AI and autonomous systems operate under defined policy. Agents read sensitive data only under purpose-bound authorization, minimum scope, full logging, and human accountability for high-impact actions.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Agent authorization broker decision records joined to the consent state.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Changes to models, prompts, and tool grants follow change control with pre-deployment evaluation, drift checks, rollback, and an approval gate.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Model-change records with evaluation results and approvals.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A maintained inventory records hardware, software, services, and data stores with an owner for each. The inventory is reconciled from authoritative discovery, not a manual list.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Inventory export with owners, reconciled against discovery, dated.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Assets and data are classified by sensitivity against a defined scheme, and handling requirements follow from the classification.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Classification scheme and a sample of classified assets/data stores.

controls.title: Secure disposal of media and equipment

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Media and equipment holding confidential data are sanitized or destroyed before disposal or reuse, with the action recorded.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Sanitization/destruction records tied to asset IDs.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Recovery objectives are set from a business impact analysis, and continuity and recovery plans are documented, resourced, and tested on cadence.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: BIA, plans, and the dated test results against objectives.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Critical data and systems are backed up on a defined schedule with backups protected and restoration verified by test, not assumption.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Backup configuration and successful restoration-test records.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Production change reaches systems only through a peer-reviewed, tracked change with required checks passing. Direct changes to protected environments are blocked; emergency changes follow a documented after-the-fact review.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Merge/change record with linked ticket, independent reviewer, and passing checks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Systems are built from approved, hardened baselines, and deviations are detected and reconciled. Baselines follow a recognized hardening standard.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Baseline definitions and a configuration-drift report.

controls.title: Encryption in transit and at rest

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Confidential data is encrypted in transit with current protocols and at rest in storage and backups. Deprecated algorithms and protocols are disallowed.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Encryption standard and a coverage report across data stores and endpoints.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic keys are generated, stored, rotated, and retired under a defined lifecycle, with access to key material restricted and logged.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Key-management procedure and key inventory with rotation records.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Confidential data is handled per its classification across storage, transmission, and sharing, and exfiltration of regulated data is monitored and constrained.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Handling standard and DLP/monitoring coverage for regulated data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Data is retained only as long as required by a defined schedule and is disposed of when the schedule expires, with disposal recorded.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Retention schedule and disposal records by data category.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Personal data is processed for a stated purpose under a documented lawful basis, and a plain-language notice describes what is collected, why, and the individual's rights.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Processing register with lawful basis and the published privacy notice.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Requests to access, correct, delete, or port personal data are honored within statutory timelines, with identity verified before action.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Rights-request log with timestamps and outcomes.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A minor's personal data is processed only after verifiable parental or guardian consent is recorded. Consent state is authoritative: absent or withdrawn consent blocks processing.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Consent register per minor with verification method and state.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Endpoints run managed protection that detects and responds to malicious activity, with coverage and health monitored centrally.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Endpoint coverage and health report.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Managed devices enforce configuration, disk encryption, and screen lock, and access from unmanaged devices to confidential data is restricted.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: MDM policy and a compliance report by device.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A documented security and privacy program defines scope, ownership, and objectives, is approved by leadership, and is reviewed at least annually. Authority and accountability for the program are assigned to a named function.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Approved program charter with version history and the annual review record.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Policies, standards, and procedures form a maintained hierarchy with named owners, a review cadence, and version control. Each document is reviewed and re-approved on cadence or on material change.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Policy register listing owner, version, last-review date, and approval.

controls.title: Roles, responsibilities, and segregation of duties

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security responsibilities are assigned by role and documented in a RACI. Conflicting duties are separated; where separation is impractical, a compensating control is recorded.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: RACI matrix and the segregation-of-duties exception register.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Control health and program performance are measured and reported to leadership on a fixed cadence, with material risks escalated. Metrics are computed from systems of record, not assembled by hand.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Periodic leadership report and the underlying computed metric set.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Personnel are screened proportionate to role before access, and acknowledge security and confidentiality obligations. A disciplinary path exists for violations.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Screening records and signed acknowledgements.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access is granted, changed, and revoked from authoritative HR events. Leaver access is removed on the same day the leaver event fires; the feed is the trigger, not a ticket.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Provisioning and deprovisioning records joined to the HR feed.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access to systems and data is reviewed on a fixed cadence against role and employment status; unjustified access is removed. Service and non-human accounts are reviewed on the same cadence as people.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Recertification record joined to the IdP and HRIS, with the revocation timestamp.

controls.title: Least privilege and privileged access management

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access follows least privilege. Privileged access is brokered, time-bound where feasible, and separately logged. Standing administrative access is minimized.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Privileged-access grant records and the session log.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Users authenticate with unique identities and phishing-resistant multi-factor where supported. MFA is enforced for remote and administrative access.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Authentication policy and an MFA-coverage report by system.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Service accounts, API keys, and workload identities are registered with an owner, scoped to least privilege, and rotated or expired. No standing secret without an owner.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Non-human identity register with owner, scope, and rotation status.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incidents are detected, triaged, contained, and recorded against a governed plan, including AI scope breaches. Every incident gets a post-incident review.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Incident records with detection, containment, and review links.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: When an incident meets a statutory or contractual threshold, affected parties and regulators are notified within required windows, with the decision and its basis recorded.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Notification decision log with timelines and basis.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security-relevant events ship to a central store and are monitored for defined conditions that alert a tracked queue. Logs capture what, when, where, source, outcome, and identity.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: SIEM coverage report and alert-acknowledgement records.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Logs are protected against alteration with write-once or equivalent integrity controls and retained for a defined period. Clocks are synchronized to an authoritative source.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Retention configuration, integrity-check results, and time-sync status.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Networks are segmented by trust and sensitivity, and traffic crossing boundaries is filtered by default-deny rules that are reviewed on cadence.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Network diagram, firewall ruleset, and the rule-review record.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Remote access to internal resources is authenticated, encrypted, and least-privilege, and administrative access originates from controlled paths.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Remote-access configuration and an access-path review.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Physical access to facilities and data-bearing equipment is restricted, logged, and reviewed. Where infrastructure is cloud-hosted, provider attestations are inherited and tracked.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Physical access records or the inherited provider attestation register.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Risk is assessed using a documented, repeatable method that estimates likelihood and impact in defined terms. Assessments run on cadence and on significant change.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: The methodology document and a dated assessment produced from it.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identified risks are recorded in a register with an owner, treatment decision, and target date. Accepted risk is approved at an authority level matched to its severity.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Risk register with treatment decisions and acceptance approvals.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security requirements and checks are built into design, build, test, and deploy stages, and a release cannot pass without its required gates emitting evidence.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Pipeline gate configuration and gate results per release.

controls.title: Software supply chain and dependency integrity

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Third-party and open-source components are inventoried, scanned for known vulnerabilities, and verified for integrity before use. Build provenance is recorded.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Software bill of materials and dependency-scan results.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Secrets are stored in a managed vault, never in source or configuration, and are scanned for in code. Exposed secrets are rotated on detection.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Secrets-scanning results and vault usage evidence.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Personnel complete security awareness training on hire and on cadence, with role-based training for higher-risk roles and tracked completion.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Training completion records by person and role.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Third parties with system or data access are tiered by what they can touch, assessed before onboarding, bound by security and processing terms, and reassessed on cadence by tier.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Vendor register with tier, assessment, contract terms, and assurance expiry.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where personal or sensitive data flows to subprocessors, processing terms, breach-notice windows, and transfer mechanisms are in place and recorded.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Subprocessor list with executed terms and transfer mechanisms.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Vulnerabilities are discovered from multiple vantage points, normalized into one queue with severity and exposure, and remediated within SLAs enforced as an aging clock.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Vulnerability queue with SLA aging and remediation records.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Independent testing exercises the environment on cadence and after significant change, and findings feed the remediation queue and the risk register.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Evidence: Test reports and the tracked remediation of findings.
